text:
Alex Chen: T-minus 45m to change window. Quick preflight checklist: canary schedule? model pins locked? rollback playbook reachable? release notes published? Reply with short status. @deploy-bot please queue canary when ready.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued (canary-2759991110). Planned start +10m, 10% traffic for 15m observation. Logs: https://deploy.internal/canary/2759991110 :white_check_mark:

Maria Gomez: Model pin for text-gen-v2 confirmed (sha: ab12c3). Embeddings still on v1.4 — keeping that until evals hit target.

Samir: Staging smoke done: 95p latency 210ms, errors 0.3%. Logs in /staging/smoke/2759. Recommend enabling prefix KV cache for canary to match production perf.

Jen L: Release notes live: /docs/releases/2026-03-21-release.md. Included rollback steps and feature-flag instructions. Ops note: set `feature.toggle.new-reranker=false` during canary.

ops-runner: Rollback/ownership: @Samir on rollback exec, @Maria on model revert, @Alex on traffic gating. Runbook: https://wiki/release-runbooks/2759991110. Provisioned extra burst capacity for first 30m.

Alex Chen: Two quick Qs: 1) any DB migrations outstanding? 2) Can we hot-unpin during freeze if needed? @Jen L

Jen L: No DB migrations in this change. Hot-unpin during freeze only for SEV-level incidents — must post in #release-war-room and get two approvers (Eng + PM).

Maria Gomez: Canary will target EU region. EU serving nodes at 72% CPU now, should be fine but watch autoscale.

Samir: Will monitor dashboards. Prepared quick scale command: `kubectl scale --replicas=3 deployment/serving-eu` if needed.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled to start at 2759991170 (+60s). Config: 10% traffic, fallback text-gen-v1, alerts: latency/error thresholds set.

Alex Chen: Final call — any blockers? If none, proceed with canary and freeze merges for 90 minutes.

Maria Gomez: :thumbsup: no blockers from ML.

Jen L: :white_check_mark: release notes and approvals all good.

Samir: :eyes: standing by, will abort if errors >1%.

ops-runner: :rocket: canary live, monitoring in #release-metrics.

Alex Chen: Go for it. Opening change-window sheet and marking current window: https://sheet/launch-windows/2759991110

deploy-bot: Canary live at 2759991180. Observability: https://metrics/2759991110. React with :deploy: to acknowledge.

Alex Chen: Thanks team — watch alerts and call rollback if any sustained degradation.
